title: Figure 2.4: IEC Landmine Detection Project at Kyoto University (presentation slide)
description: Presentation slide titled 'Project of Landmine Detection' from the Institute of Advanced Energy, Kyoto University. It shows a schematic of a D-D neutron source with gamma-ray/neutron detectors and shields above the ground, and a color illustration of a crane-mounted vehicle carrying the IEC source, detectors and camera over soil. Text boxes list R&D of LM detection (diagnostics, tomography, total system) and R&D of compact IEC, with a note that the project is supported by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST).
